scripts.build:web:dev: pnpm --dir web exec vite build --mode development
scripts.build:go: CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X myprintables/internal/cli.version=0.1.3 -X myprintables/internal/cli.commit=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none) -X myprintables/internal/cli.buildDate=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" -o bin/myprintables ./cmd/myprintables
scripts.clean: rm -rf bin tmp internal/web/dist web/node_modules node_modules
